theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiTM_blowUp_tendsto_of_contDiff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ σ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (ρ₁ C : ℝ), 0 < ρ₁ → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → (∀ R : ℝ, σ (Metric.ball 0 R) < ∞) → (∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, φ (blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y, φ y ∂σ))) → ∀ f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, f (blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y, f y ∂σ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
